warnings: Pile-group footings on hardwood piles Ø6" x 6.00 m (sections at the top right of the sheet, plans ขยายฐานราก F1 / F2 1:20 below them). Plan sizes from the printed edge/pile-spacing chains (kept in *_printed_as); thickness from the section chains 0.35 + 0.10 (F1) and 0.50 + 0.10 (F2); 0.10 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.10 compacted sand below; 1.20 from ระดับดินเดิม to the footing underside; 0.05 cover.
F1's pile-count text reads 'จำนวน 1? ต้น' with the second digit lost; the plan draws a 4 x 4 grid = 16 piles — taken from the plan. F2 prints 30 and draws 5 x 6 = 30.

The same marks also have a prestressed-pile alternative on this sheet (รูปตัด C1 / C2 1:20 with ขยายฐานราก F / F2) — recorded in its own file _view7_section_alt_footings_prestressed.json so the two designs of one mark do not collide in one file (house 157 precedent).
